title: Oven Roasted Korean Chicken Legs Skewers
description: A savory and spicy Korean dish featuring chicken legs, perfect for a date night, with a rich beurre-monte sauce and low sodium content
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, Gochujang, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger.
Add the chicken legs to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken legs onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with sesame oil.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the beurre-monte sauce by melting the butter in a saucepan over low heat.
Remove the chicken from the oven and brush with the beurre-monte sauce.
Return the chicken to the oven and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the sauce is caramelized.
Remove the chicken from the oven and sprinkle with chopped green onions.
